title: Weighted score total
description: A scorecard keeps two parallel lists: the points awarded for each criterion and the weight of each criterion. Return the weighted total: the sum of points[i] * weights[i] over all positions i that exist in both lists. If the lists differ in length, the extra elements of the longer list are ignored. Empty lists give 0. Values may be negative.
notes: Tests the shared-prefix rule (unequal lengths both ways), negatives, empty lists and a large product. No division.
